requirements.description: Natural-language brief: Design a safe 5 V control input with an RC-delay gate driving a 2N7002 open-drain signal output. Add a 10k pull-up to 5 V, 1k gate resistor, 100k gate pull-down and 10nF gate capacitor. Include 3-pin input and 2-pin output connectors. Generate a 36x24 mm two-layer PCB.
acceptance: Low CTRL should leave OUT high
High CTRL should pull OUT low after the gate delay
Component ratings and 2N7002 vendor model must be independently checked
Do not release a board without zero KiCad ERC/DRC and reviewed sourced footprints

requirements.description: J1 has 5V, CTRL and GND pins. J2 has OUT and GND. Q1 has Drain to OUT, Gate to the filtered control node, Source to GND.
acceptance: Exact physical pin-net membership is preserved across TSX and KiCad exports
